text: 各位同学大家好,我是来自民办上海上外静安外国语中学的游老师。Nice to meet you.Welcome to today's class.Please make sure you have your student's book,worksheet and pen ready.In the previous lesson, we know Panda021 started a topic online, and he has received a reply from Mikko.Look, Panda021 has just got another reply for his post.Who writes this post?Yes, Anna does.Do you still remember who Panda021 is?Yes, he is Wang Yiming.But why does he use the name Panda021 and the cartoon photo?Jasping, what do you think?Because there are a lot of strangers online, it's not very safe to use the real name and photo.Wonderful.I agree with you.We've learned a lot from Dr.Hu in this unit.He also wants to teach us a very important skill when we post online.Let's take a look.Yes, do not give out your personal information like your name, school, family details, and so on.Also, do not believe everything you read or hear online.Always remember safety first.We know Panda021 has got two replies.Let's read the reply from Anna together.Please open your student's book and turn to page 22.What does Anna write about in her reply?Match the words A to F with the sentences in the post.There are two more words than you need.同学们,Anna的帖子里都写了哪些方面呢?请将帖子中的句子与右边表示方面的单词相对应,其中有两个是多余的单词。And how do you match the words with the sentences?Jason, please.Anna writes about these aspects, timetable, subjects, activities, and place.In the first sentence, I go to a middle school in Germany.She writes about the place.The next sentence is about the timetable.Our school day starts at 7.and ends at 1.The next two sentences are about the subjects.We can know the number of the lessons every day and her favorite lessons.As for activities, she writes the next three sentences.Good job.Boys and girls, have you matched in the same way?And the aspects Anna writes in her reply can answer the questions from Panda 0 to 1.Where do you live?What is your school day like?What do you like most about your school?Now, it's time for you to write down the aspects and expressions in these three parts of your student's book.First, you can write down the key aspects to answer Panda 0 to 1's questions.These expressions are all from Anna's post.Do you know any other expressions?Cherry, please.When I want to write about the place, I can write, I am a student from Shanghai, China.I will also introduce my timetable like Anna when I start my school day and end my school day.I will also write about the lunch break.Thank you, Cherry.We can write about the lunch break like this.When you write about the subjects or activities, can you think of other ways to express?Alice, of all the subjects, I like science best.Great!I like something best just means something is my favorite.Besides these aspects, what else can you write about your school life?Please take 30 seconds to think about that.Now, let's listen to my students' ideas.Jasmine, please.I can write about my favorite teacher and my friends.They are all very important to my school life.What else?Elwin, please.I want to write about our campus environment.It's very big and beautiful.There are even VR classrooms.That's really cool!Lucas?My school has many interesting and meaningful projects.I can learn a lot from that.I would like to write about the project.Yes, Michael also writes about projects in his online post.Alicia, what else can you write about?Food.The food in the canteen of our school is so delicious.After four lessons in the morning, a wonderful lunch always gives me much energy and joy.Fantastic!Boys and girls, I believe you also have a lot of brilliant ideas.School life is really attractive, isn't it?Now, I suppose you are ready and quite excited to start writing.Do you know there is a very important tool that can help us write better?Yes, a checklist.Usually, a checklist should include the items and the stars or points you will give yourself or others.Before writing, a checklist can be very useful to guide our writing.It can also be used to check your own and your partner's work after writing.Can you think of any items for the checklist?Cherry, what's your idea?Different aspects.We should write about our school life and try to write different aspects.You are right.Writing different aspects about the school life can make people know how colorful your school life is.Any other items to be put in the checklist?Alice, what do you think?Miku and Anna both use the present simple tense to write about their school lives.We should also write in the present simple tense.Yes, when we write about our school life, we mainly write about things that are true now or things we usually do.So, we should write sentences in the present simple tense.Think about the rules you learned in the grammar lesson and try your best to use them correctly.Oh, Dr.Hu has something to tell us.Let's read his words.Begin a sentence with a capital letter and a sentence with a full stop or a question mark or an exclamation mark.Thank you, Dr.These two points are very important for us to learn.Why not put them into our checklist?For each item, you can give three stars at most.Boys and girls, please take out your worksheet and put the items into the table on your worksheet.While taking down these items, please try to remember them well.You will have two minutes.Let's get started.When you finish your writing, remember to use the checklist to check your writing.我們來看看我的學生Cherry的作品Cherry,你能告訴我們你如何檢查自己的書籍嗎?是的,我用書籍來檢查我的作品我寫了不同的部分關於我的學校例如時間表、時間表、時間表、時間表、時間表、時間表我寫下了不同的部分關於我的學校例如時間表、時間表、時間表、時間表、時間表、時間表、時間表、時間表、時間表、時間表、時間表、時間表、時間表活動、圖表、四方以此作為題目,我會給自己三個星並嘗試寫上現在的簡單語句我看不出任何錯誤我給自己三個星額,是第二和第三個項目。然後我猜猜,是第四個項目的錯誤。我學校裡有很多好朋友。我每個星期天下午都會去學術學院。這是兩句話,可能是一個完整的停頓。很棒,Cherry!我喜歡你分享自己做自己檢查的過程。你也說得對。就像我們學到的Dr.Hoo,當我們結束一句話,我們應該用一個完整的停頓。你做了一個很棒的工作,看到你寫的錯誤,因為這很難看到。各位女孩們,你寫的如何?你找到錯誤嗎?你會檢查自己的寫作嗎?寫作後,寫作者可以幫助你。你喜歡給他或她每個項目的星額多少?你有沒有建議幫助他或她改善?別忘記拿機會來從你的夥伴學習。去讀書,你會有兩分鐘。TOM,你就是Cherry的夥伴。我們剛剛讀了Cherry的作品,我聽到她的自己的思想和寫作。我等不及知道你會給她多少個星額。你有沒有空間讓她改善?她寫得很好,所以我給了她三個星額,但我認為她寫的寫作的地方不太好。她最喜歡什麼學校?所以我給她兩個星額。可能她可以把她的第一個寫作的地方加進去。是,TOM。Cherry,在寫作的最後,你為什麼不加一個或兩個寫作去表達你最喜歡什麼學校?這很重要,對吧?各位女孩們,我希望你們可以從學生檔上學到很多東西,並且你們可以繼續在今天的工作中改善寫作。在今天的課堂中,你們已經讀了安娜的另一篇文章,並且自己在學校的生活中寫了一篇回覆。在這段過程中,你們已經學會了寫作,如何寫作,以及如何使用檔案來指導和檢查寫作。你們做了一個很好的工作,我非常高興看到你們的進步。這是你們今天做的工作。一,在學生檔上寫作的學校生活中寫了一篇文章。二,在11個文章中寫了一篇實驗。謝謝你收聽,下次見!
